## Activity

During December 2019, River Outreach completed 42 captures. The activity provides a record of the imaging workload undertaken at the site during the month. All captures were submitted for review through the usual operational process.

## Image quality

Of the 42 captures, 2 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 4.8 per cent. The image-quality results should continue to be monitored as part of routine site oversight. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so they can be reviewed and addressed through the appropriate support process.

## Grading

There were 6 referable results among the captures reviewed. The median lag from capture to grading was 1 day. This indicates that grading was generally completed promptly during December 2019. The site should continue to record image-quality concerns and maintain the current escalation process for equipment or camera problems.
